==English==

===Etymology 1===
From {{bor|en|non|Askr}}, from {{m|non|askr||ash tree}}.

====Proper noun====
{{en-proper noun}}

# {{lb|en|Norse mythology}} The [[first]] [[male]] [[human]], according to the [[w:Poetic Edda|Poetic Edda]].

===Etymology 2===
Borrowed from {{bor|en|sv|Ask}}, from {{m|sv|ask||ash tree}}, ultimately also from {{m|non|askr||ash tree}}. {{doublet|en|Ash}}.

====Proper noun====
{{en-proper noun|s}}

# {{surname|en|from=Swedish}}.

=====Statistics=====
* According to the 2010 United States Census, ''Ask'' is the 37955<sup>th</sup> most common surname in the United States, belonging to 585 individuals. ''Ask'' is most common among White (95.56%) individuals.
